# Border

Header: `winui/ui/containers/Border.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/containers/Border.hpp`.

One child inside a background, a border and padding.

Measures to the child's size plus border thickness and padding on each side, and arranges the child inside both. The background fills the rect inside the border, and the border is drawn inside the element's own bounds, both with [corner_radius()](#corner_radius). Input, focus, ticks and popups pass through to the child, so wrapping a subtree in a [Border](#uiborder) changes only its look and its size. Set the child with [ContentHost::set_child()](../controls/content-host.md#set_child).

Example: 
```cpp
auto border = std::make_unique<ui::BorderControl>();
border->set_background(ui::colors::White);
border->set_border_brush(ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 215, 0));
border->set_border_thickness(ui::Thickness{2.0f});
border->set_corner_radius(4.0f);
border->set_padding(ui::Thickness{12.0f});
ui::TextControl* label = border->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Inside a border"));
window.set_content(std::move(border));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::Border{
    .background       = ui::colors::White,
    .border_brush     = ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 215, 0),
    .border_thickness = ui::Thickness{2.0f},
    .corner_radius    = 4.0f,
    .padding          = ui::Thickness{12.0f},
    .content          = ui::Text{.text = "Inside a border"},
});
```

## `ui::Border`

A background, a border and padding around one child. Builds a [ui::BorderControl](#uibordercontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::Color gold = ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 215, 0);

window.set_content(ui::Border{
    .background           = ui::colors::White,
    .border_brush         = gold,
    .border_thickness     = ui::Thickness{2.0f},
    .corner_radius        = 4.0f,
    .padding              = ui::Thickness{12.0f},
    .horizontal_alignment = ui::Alignment::Leading,
    .content              = ui::Text{.text = "Text inside a border"},
});
```

```cpp
ui::Border{
    .background, .border_brush, .border_thickness, .corner_radius, .padding, .shadow,
    .elevation, .clip_content, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height,
    .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip,
    .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

## `ui::BorderControl`

Derives from `ui::ContentHost`.

One child inside a background, a border and padding.

Measures to the child's size plus border thickness and padding on each side, and arranges the child inside both. The background fills the rect inside the border, and the border is drawn inside the element's own bounds, both with [corner_radius()](#corner_radius). Input, focus, ticks and popups pass through to the child, so wrapping a subtree in a [Border](#uiborder) changes only its look and its size. Set the child with [ContentHost::set_child()](../controls/content-host.md#set_child).

Example: 
```cpp
auto border = std::make_unique<ui::BorderControl>();
border->set_background(ui::colors::White);
border->set_border_brush(ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 215, 0));
border->set_border_thickness(ui::Thickness{2.0f});
border->set_corner_radius(4.0f);
border->set_padding(ui::Thickness{12.0f});
ui::TextControl* label = border->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Inside a border"));
window.set_content(std::move(border));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::Border{
    .background       = ui::colors::White,

    .border_thickness = ui::Thickness{2.0f},
```

### hit_test_transparent

```cpp
bool hit_test_transparent() const override
```

Returns false, so the border is hit anywhere in its bounds, even where it draws nothing.

### BorderControl

```cpp
BorderControl() = default
```

An empty border: no child, no background, no border, no padding.

### background

```cpp
const std::optional<Color>& background() const
```

The fixed background color. nullopt, the default, draws nothing. It also reads nullopt while a theme resource is set (see [background_resource()](#background_resource)). A [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) is read again whenever the border is drawn, so it follows theme switches.

### background_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor background_resource() const
```

The theme resource set as the background, or nullptr when a fixed color or none is set.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(std::optional<Color> color)
```

Sets a fixed background color, or none with nullopt, and clears any theme resource. Redraws.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(ThemeColor resource)
```

Sets a theme resource as the background, for example `[](const Theme& t) { return t.colors().background; }`. Redraws.

### background_transition

```cpp
const std::optional<BrushTransition>& background_transition() const
```

How the background changes color. With a [BrushTransition](../tree/brush-transition.md) set, a later change of what the background draws, such as a new color or a resource under a new theme, blends from the color on screen. nullopt, the default, changes it at once.

### set_background_transition

```cpp
void set_background_transition(std::optional<BrushTransition> transition)
```

Sets the background transition. Applies to the next change, and a blend already running keeps going.

### border_brush

```cpp
const std::optional<Color>& border_brush() const
```

The fixed border color. nullopt, the default, draws no border, though [border_thickness()](#border_thickness) still takes up room.

### border_brush_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor border_brush_resource() const
```

The theme resource set as the border brush, or nullptr.

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(std::optional<Color> color)
```

Sets a fixed border color and clears any theme resource set with the other overload. Redraws.

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(ThemeColor resource)
```

Sets a theme resource as the border brush, read again under every theme. It takes precedence over a fixed [border_brush()](#border_brush). Redraws.

### border_thickness

```cpp
const Thickness& border_thickness() const
```

The border width per side in DIPs, zero by default. It takes up room whether or not a border brush is set.

### set_border_thickness

```cpp
void set_border_thickness(const Thickness& thickness)
```

Sets the border width. Updates layout and redraws.

### corner_radius

```cpp
float corner_radius() const
```

The corner radius in DIPs, one value for all four corners. 0, the default, gives square corners. Applies to the background and the border alike.

### set_corner_radius

```cpp
void set_corner_radius(float radius)
```

Sets the corner radius. Redraws only, since layout doesn't depend on the radius.

### padding

```cpp
const Thickness& padding() const
```

The padding in DIPs between the inside of the border and the child, zero by default.

### set_padding

```cpp
void set_padding(const Thickness& padding)
```

Sets the padding. Updates layout.

### shadow

```cpp
bool shadow() const
```

Whether the border casts a drop shadow sized by [elevation()](#elevation). It draws two black shadows, ambient and directional, whose blur, offset and opacity grow with the depth and differ per theme. Off by default.

### set_shadow

```cpp
void set_shadow(bool on)
```

Turns the shadow on or off. Redraws only, since the shadow takes no layout room.

### elevation

```cpp
float elevation() const
```

The elevation the shadow is sized by, in DIPs. 0 by default, and below 4 casts no shadow. It moves nothing on screen. It is the same value as [Element::translation()](../tree/element.md#translation).z, so a translation animation or transition deepens the shadow as it runs.

### set_elevation

```cpp
void set_elevation(float z)
```

Sets only the z of [Element::translation()](../tree/element.md#translation), keeping x and y.

### clip_content

```cpp
bool clip_content() const
```

Whether the child is clipped to the inside of the border, rounded corners included. Off by default. When on, a picture in a rounded [Border](#uiborder) follows the corners, and a child drawn past the edge, through a negative margin or a transform, is cut off there.

### set_clip_content

```cpp
void set_clip_content(bool clip)
```

Turns clipping on or off. Redraws.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

Returns true, since measuring touches only the child.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The child's desired size plus border thickness and padding on each side.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Gives the child the rect inside the border and the padding.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the shadow if it is on, the background and the border, then the child. The child is clipped to the inside of the border while [clip_content()](#clip_content) is on.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances the background transition, then forwards to the child.
